title: Job description template
description: Configured once for the whole company — every JD a recruiter writes follows it

company.title: Company identity
company.logoHint: PNG or JPG, max 2MB. The logo appears at the top of every JD file.
company.name: Company name
company.documentTitleHint: Printed centred above the info table — e.g. "JOB OPENING". This titles the document type, not the position.

style.title: Presentation
style.fontHint: The font must exist on the server; unknown fonts fall back to Arial.

sections.title: JD sections
sections.description: Toggle, rename and reorder the sections printed in the file. Section keys are fixed — saved JD content is looked up by those keys.

preview.label: Preview
preview.sampleLine: A recruiter fills this section in when writing the JD.
preview.note: The preview is APPROXIMATE: browser fonts differ from the server’s, so page breaks may shift by a line or two.

errors.loadFailed: Could not load the JD template.
errors.saveFailed: Could not save the JD template.
